The author's reference `pipeline_schematic_draft_v3.pdf` informs the route and
station visual grammar only. All scientific labels below come from this
project's current analysis registry and the validated 16S integration.
Routes indicate data provenance, not biological causation. Colour identifies
the omics route; the header retains the fixed experimental-condition colours.

Run from the repository root:

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/build_workflow_metro.qmd /absolute/new/output/directory
```

```{r}
#| label: workflow-metro
library(grid)
source("R/figure_style.R")
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
out <- if (length(args)) args[[1]] else
  "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived/workflow_metro_v10"
if (dir.exists(out)) stop("Use a new output directory to preserve versions")
dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE)

W <- 1870; H <- 950
ink <- "#243341"; muted <- "#627181"; pale <- "#E5EAF0"
route <- c(amplicon = "#147D92", metagenome = "#B47A20",
           virus = "#BE5363", transcriptome = "#416EB0")
tx <- function(x, y, s, size = 11, colour = ink, face = "plain", rot = 0,
               just = "left") {
  grid.text(s, x/W, 1-y/H, just = just, rot = rot,
            gp = gpar(fontfamily = "sans", fontsize = size,
                      col = colour, fontface = face, lineheight = 1.25))
}
ln <- function(x, y, col, width = 4, dash = "solid", arrow = NULL) {
  grid.lines(x/W, 1-y/H, gp = gpar(col = col, lwd = width,
    lineend = "round", linejoin = "round", lty = dash), arrow = arrow)
}
station <- function(x, y, col, label = NULL, sub = NULL) {
  grid.roundrect(x/W, 1-y/H, 15/W, 27/H, r = unit(7, "pt"),
                 gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = col, lwd = 1.8))
  if (!is.null(label)) tx(x-2, y-27, label, 10.5, face = "bold", rot = 36)
  if (!is.null(sub)) tx(x, y+30, sub, 9, muted, just = "centre")
}
terminal <- function(x, y, col) {
  grid.circle(x/W, 1-y/H, r = unit(4, "pt"),
              gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = col, lwd = 2))
}
endpoint <- function(y, col, title, body) {
  ln(c(864,864), c(y-23,y+38), col, 2.5)
  tx(881,y-15,title,12,face="bold")
  tx(881,y+12,body,10,muted)
}
draw <- function() {
  grid.newpage()
  ref <- "#626B78"; host <- "#697D45"
  tx(38,35,"Phage-UV: the integrated multi-omics journey",23,face="bold")
  tx(38,65,"One experiment / complementary measurements / shared references / connected evidence",11,muted)
  # nf-core-inspired vertical stage bands, with no detached panels.
  bands <- data.frame(x=c(185,395,680,990,1175,1445),w=c(198,273,298,173,258,300),
                      label=c("PREPARE","ASSEMBLE","RECOVER REFERENCES","UNIFY","QUANTIFY","INTERPRET"))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(bands))) {
    grid.roundrect((bands$x[i]+bands$w[i]/2)/W,1-505/H,bands$w[i]/W,778/H,
                   r=unit(8,"pt"),gp=gpar(fill=if(i%%2) "#F4F5F7" else "#FAFBFC",col=NA))
    tx(bands$x[i]+14,139,bands$label[i],9,muted,face="bold")
  }
  stop <- function(x,y,col,title=NULL,subtitle=NULL,dy=-43,rot=0,just="centre") {
    station(x,y,col)
    if(!is.null(title)) tx(x,y+dy,title,10.5,face="bold",rot=rot,just=just)
    if(!is.null(subtitle)) tx(x,y+dy+18,subtitle,8.5,muted,just=just)
  }
  finish <- function(x,y,col,title,subtitle) {
    terminal(x,y,col)
    tx(x+18,y-8,title,11,face="bold")
    tx(x+18,y+12,subtitle,9,muted)
  }
  # The experiment is the common origin of all routes.
  ln(c(75,130,175,215),c(465,465,245,245),route[["amplicon"]],4)
  ln(c(75,150,195,290),c(465,465,410,410),route[["metagenome"]],4)
  ln(c(75,150,195,290),c(465,465,530,530),route[["transcriptome"]],4)
  grid.circle(75/W,1-465/H,r=unit(9,"pt"),gp=gpar(fill="white",col=ink,lwd=2))
  tx(39,374,"12 samples",12,face="bold")
  tx(39,396,"3 cycles",10,muted)
  tx(39,414,"2 phases",10,muted)
  tx(39,489,"Control",10,phage_uv_condition_colours[["control"]],"bold")
  tx(39,509,"Phage-UV",10,phage_uv_condition_colours[["phage_uv"]],"bold")
  tx(39,552,"Initial /",9,muted)
  tx(39,569,"backflush",9,muted)

  # The amplicon route travels directly to the same community endpoint.
  ln(c(215,1050,1105,1500),c(245,245,210,210),route[["amplicon"]],4.5)
  stop(290,245,route[["amplicon"]],"16S cDNA","cutadapt")
  stop(515,245,route[["amplicon"]],"Denoise","DADA2")
  stop(800,245,route[["amplicon"]],"Assign taxonomy","SILVA / 2,700 ASVs")

  # MG and MT enter a shared, sample-specific coassembly station.
  ln(c(290,390,450,605),c(410,410,454,454),route[["metagenome"]],4.5)
  ln(c(290,390,450,605),c(530,530,470,470),route[["transcriptome"]],4.5)
  stop(290,410,route[["metagenome"]],"Metagenomes","Read QC / 12 runs")
  stop(290,530,route[["transcriptome"]])
  tx(220,576,"Metatranscriptomes",10.5,face="bold",just="centre")
  tx(220,596,"QC + rRNA filtering",8.5,muted,just="centre")
  tx(220,613,"23 runs",8.5,muted,just="centre")
  grid.roundrect(535/W,1-462/H,17/W,44/H,r=unit(8,"pt"),
                 gp=gpar(fill="white",col=ink,lwd=1.8))
  tx(530,402,"MG + MT coassembly",11,face="bold",just="centre")
  tx(530,423,"MEGAHIT / per sample",9,muted,just="centre")
  ln(c(605,605),c(454,470),ref,2)

  # Parallel assemblies also start from the same QC-passed read streams.
  # Draw underpasses where these input paths cross a route without joining.
  ln(c(344,368,368,437,470),c(410,434,604,661,661),route[["metagenome"]],2)
  ln(c(344,355,355,425,470),c(530,541,617,673,673),route[["transcriptome"]],2)
  ln(c(360,379),c(530,530),"white",5)
  ln(c(360,379),c(530,530),route[["transcriptome"]],4.5)
  grid.roundrect(480/W,1-667/H,17/W,42/H,r=unit(8,"pt"),
                 gp=gpar(fill="white",col=ink,lwd=1.6))
  tx(480,713,"Single-omics assemblies",10.5,face="bold",just="centre")
  tx(480,735,"MG: Penguin / MT: MEGAHIT + Penguin",8.5,muted,just="centre")
  ln(c(480,500,500,523),c(645,617,510,485),muted,1.2,"dashed",
     grid::arrow(length=unit(4,"pt"),type="closed"))
  tx(535,596,"MT contigs",8.5,muted)

  # Coassembly separates into genome and viral reference routes.
  ln(c(605,665,720,970,1045),c(462,370,370,370,440),route[["metagenome"]],4.5)
  ln(c(605,665,720,970,1045),c(462,615,615,615,474),route[["virus"]],4.5)
  ln(c(490,600,655,720),c(667,667,615,615),route[["virus"]],2.5)
  stop(738,370,route[["metagenome"]],"Bin & refine","MAGScoT")
  stop(906,370,route[["metagenome"]],"Dereplicate","dRep / across samples",dy=35)
  stop(738,615,route[["virus"]],"Viral discovery")
  stop(906,615,route[["virus"]],"Pool & cluster","Vclust / across samples")
  tx(825,661,"geNomad / VirSorter2 / VirALM",8.5,muted,just="centre")
  tx(825,680,"DeepMicroClass for coassemblies",8.5,muted,just="centre")
  grid.roundrect(1060/W,1-457/H,24/W,62/H,r=unit(9,"pt"),
                 gp=gpar(fill="white",col=ink,lwd=2))
  tx(1060,351,"Unified",12,face="bold",just="centre")
  tx(1060,373,"MAG/vOTU",12,face="bold",just="centre")
  tx(1060,395,"catalogue",12,face="bold",just="centre")
  tx(1078,530,"348 MAGs + vOTUs",8.5,muted)
  tx(1078,551,"Annotated reference",7.5,muted)
  tx(1078,568,"Gene coordinates",7.5,muted)
  # Sequence catalogue supplies a common reference for both read types.
  ln(c(1072,1142,1195),c(457,457,457),ref,2.5)
  tx(1135,483,"reference",8.5,muted,just="centre")

  # Continuous MG and MT bypass tracks retain reads for remapping.
  ln(c(310,345,1100,1195),c(410,308,308,416),route[["metagenome"]],3)
  tx(660,286,"QC-passed MG reads",9,route[["metagenome"]],just="centre")
  ln(c(310,330,1100,1195),c(530,790,790,498),route[["transcriptome"]],3)
  tx(900,816,"QC-passed MT reads",9,route[["transcriptome"]],just="centre")
  grid.roundrect(1205/W,1-457/H,18/W,108/H,r=unit(8,"pt"),
                 gp=gpar(fill="white",col=ink,lwd=1.8))
  tx(1132,420,"Map both omics",10,face="bold",just="centre")
  tx(1132,440,"BWA-MEM",8.5,muted,just="centre")
  # MG abundance joins 16S at the community interpretation interchange.
  ln(c(1214,1300,1360,1440,1500),c(416,416,290,290,210),route[["metagenome"]],4.5)
  stop(1310,395,route[["metagenome"]],"Abundance","CoverM",dy=-35)
  finish(1500,210,route[["amplicon"]],"Community structure","Composition / diversity / trajectories")
  tx(1505,255,"MAG and phage abundance comparisons",9,muted)
  # Gene expression remains a full-universe branch.
  ln(c(1214,1260,1290,1500),c(498,498,563,563),route[["transcriptome"]],4.5)
  stop(1295,563,route[["transcriptome"]],"Gene counts","BED-guided coverage",dy=34)
  stop(1415,563,route[["transcriptome"]],"Aggregate runs","12 samples",dy=-62)
  finish(1500,563,route[["transcriptome"]],"Full-universe edgeR","361,907 features / cycle interactions")
  tx(1518,614,"Functional interpretation / MAG coherence",9,muted)

  # Host-phage evidence branches physically from the common reference.
  ln(c(1060,1060,1120,1390,1500),c(488,676,705,705,705),"white",6)
  ln(c(1060,1060,1120,1390,1500),c(488,676,705,705,705),host,3)
  stop(1275,705,host,"CRISPR host linking","SpacePHARER")
  finish(1500,705,host,"Host-phage context","86 candidate pairs")

  # MAG-only population mapping uses both MG reads and MAG representatives.
  ln(c(906,940,940,1280),c(370,340,165,165),"white",6)
  ln(c(906,940,940,1280),c(370,340,165,165),route[["metagenome"]],2.5)
  ln(c(890,925,940),c(308,180,165),"white",6)
  ln(c(890,925,940),c(308,180,165),route[["metagenome"]],2.5)
  stop(1240,165,route[["metagenome"]],"MAG-only mapping + inStrain",dy=27)
  finish(1500,165,route[["metagenome"]],"", "")
  ln(c(1280,1350,1450,1500),c(165,111,111,165),route[["metagenome"]],2.5)
  tx(1445,88,"Genomic variation / five selected MAGs",10,muted,just="centre")
  # Key is compact; grey dashed line is the assembly-contig input only.
  ln(c(45,70),c(862,862),ref,3)
  tx(82,862,"Continuous route = data flow",9,muted)
  station(348,862,ink)
  tx(370,862,"Shared station = shared operation or reference",9,muted)
  tx(760,862,"Crossings without stations do not join routes.",9,muted)
  tx(45,919,"One membrane per condition; repeated sampling describes these systems but does not replicate treatment.",9,muted)
}

# Audit the logical graph independently of drawing coordinates. All stations
# must be reachable from the physical experiment, with no orphaned branch.
edge_spec <- c(
  "samples amplicon", "samples mg_qc", "samples mt_qc",
  "amplicon asv", "asv taxonomy", "taxonomy community",
  "mg_qc coassembly", "mt_qc coassembly", "mg_qc single_omics",
  "mt_qc single_omics", "single_omics coassembly", "single_omics viral_discovery",
  "coassembly binning", "binning mag_derep", "coassembly viral_discovery",
  "viral_discovery votu_clustering", "mag_derep catalogue", "votu_clustering catalogue",
  "catalogue shared_mapping", "mg_qc shared_mapping", "mt_qc shared_mapping",
  "shared_mapping abundance", "abundance community", "shared_mapping gene_counts",
  "gene_counts aggregate_runs", "aggregate_runs full_de",
  "catalogue host_links", "mag_derep mag_only_mapping", "mg_qc mag_only_mapping"
)
edges <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind,strsplit(edge_spec," ")),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
names(edges) <- c("from","to")
nodes <- unique(c(edges$from,edges$to))
seen <- "samples"
repeat {
  expanded <- union(seen,edges$to[edges$from %in% seen])
  if(length(expanded)==length(seen)) break
  seen <- expanded
}
stopifnot(setequal(seen,nodes), !anyDuplicated(edges))
write.table(edges,file.path(out,"workflow_edges.tsv"),sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE)
write.table(data.frame(node_id=nodes,reachable_from_experiment=nodes %in% seen),
            file.path(out,"workflow_nodes.tsv"),sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE)

pdf(file.path(out,"study-analysis-workflow.pdf"),width=18.7,height=9.5,
    useDingbats=FALSE,title="Phage-UV multi-omics analysis workflow")
draw(); dev.off()
if (nzchar(Sys.which("pdftocairo"))) {
  status <- system2("pdftocairo", c("-svg", shQuote(file.path(out,"study-analysis-workflow.pdf")),
                                 shQuote(file.path(out,"study-analysis-workflow.svg"))))
  if (status != 0) stop("SVG export failed")
}
png(file.path(out,"study-analysis-workflow.png"),width=3740,height=1900,res=200)
draw(); dev.off()
files <- list.files(out,full.names=TRUE)
write.table(data.frame(file=basename(files),bytes=file.info(files)$size,
  md5=unname(tools::md5sum(files))),file.path(out,"output_checksums.md5.tsv"),
  sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE)
```
